ops.body: Routed to the Swift design lane of the v0.21 fleet migration (captain-hook/synckit Swift work, this cycle). Confirmed still open at 16b9265: the Swift client has no Authorize equivalent (Sources/DaemonKit/SocketClient.swift:722 chain), while the Go half's gap closed at the cut (see 41d041b, closed). The design question — Swift-native code-identity binding vs a Go helper — is unanswered, and two live Swift consumers (captain-hook, cc-notes helpers) depend on the answer.
